depiction_rules.notes: Recurring older clean-shaven devotee-poet. Preserve the selected older identity consistently across D003, D004, D005 and D006 while retaining the stanza-specific devotional action. In D003, show physical affliction through supported posture and limited mobility while preserving dignity; his arc moves from pain and pleading toward ecstatic devotion and peaceful lifelong worship.

visual_bible.age: Older adult scholar as shown in the selected artistic reference; exact historical age is unverified.
visual_bible.face: Consistent lined oval face with expressive dark eyes, clean-shaven cheeks and chin, dignified nose, calm thoughtful expression, and horizontal sacred-ash stripes with a central forehead mark.
visual_bible.hair: Largely shaved scalp with a small traditional dark hair tuft.
visual_bible.build: slender and physically afflicted but dignified, never grotesque
visual_bible.clothing: Simple warm-cream Kerala dhoti, sacred thread, and restrained prayer beads; use a narrow deep-maroon cloth edge only where the scene requires it.
visual_bible.continuity_markers: Same older clean-shaven face, age lines, ash markings, small dark tuft, sacred thread, modest beads, cream dhoti and slender body proportions in every scene.

never: no royal crown or ornate jewelry
no changing clean-shaven face, apparent age, ash markings or hair tuft
